entries.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
entries.answer: Success is judged by whether QIF can explain how to block solution-biased or boundary-confused work before implementation: documented review workflow, negative acceptance model, data boundary and concept comprehension quality intents, discovery patterns, examples, and verifier boundaries are added without making QIF depend on AOF.
entries.expectation_state: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation

entries.question: need validation で何が確定したか
entries.answer: Validated as a docs-only v0.3.1 candidate. The chosen path adds standalone QIF guidance and Discovery Layer pattern extensions; runtime schemas, UI, external integrations, release/tagging, and AOF-specific enforcement are out of scope.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: The guidance is documentation-only; executable schemas, examples, verifier rules, and pilot packages for pre-implementation review are not implemented yet.
entries.expectation_state: The slice adds standalone QIF guidance for reviewing proposed changes before implementation, defining negative acceptance, and extending Discovery Patterns for solution bias, boundary confusion, and concept comprehension.
entries.mismatch_state: The guidance is documentation-only; executable schemas, examples, verifier rules, and pilot packages for pre-implementation review are not implemented yet.
